notes.title: Exciting News & Patch Update for Sneak Out Players!
notes.notes:
We’ve tackled the server issues in China and fine-tuned the gameplay mechanics. Thanks to your support, we've lifted our Steam rating from "mostly negative" to "mixed." We’re on a mission to elevate Sneak Out even further!

Latest Patch Now Live on Steam!

Ensure you're playing the latest version of Sneak Out by updating your game now! 

Here's what's new ⤵️

- Decreased ally stuns: More fluid gameplay.
- Reaper Hello There: Cooldown fix applied for balanced play.
- Improved Clown Skill Descriptions: Clarity to enhance your strategy.
- Armor T-Pose Bug: Now fixed for a smoother experience.
- Friend List Sorting: Enhanced functionality.
- Ghost Spawn Bug: Resolved to maintain game integrity.
- East Maps Tasks: Bugs squashed for a seamless mission.


We also need your help❗

☑️ Try It Out: If you haven’t played recently, jump back in and see the improvements for yourself!

☑️ Update Your Review: If your initial experience was less than perfect, consider revisiting your Steam review. Your updated feedback is invaluable!

☑️ Join the Conversation: Share your thoughts in our Discord channels #ask-sneak-out and #sneak-out-suggestion!

Thank you for your commitment to Sneak Out. Together, we’re pushing forward to make this the game we all know it can be!

notes.title: New patch update for Sneak Out and what's next...? Read more here!
notes.notes:
Hi sneaky players! Here’s a message from our Chief Gaming Officer at Kinguin - Michał Kaczmarek who’s responsible for Sneak Out! 



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190768/8221268ffd3101bb41ed447a8eb3c1493e2e06cd.png

First, thank you for your incredible engagement during our game release! I want to let you know that we hear you loud and clear. We are working on making things right ❤

🔹 We have eliminated the resource-based economy from our game - for fairness

🔸 Items now spawn on the map directly, the same as in the playtests, as you’ve requested

🔹 We have refunded all Shards spent on upgrading the garden and have dramatically cut the skin prices

🔸 We are also tackling the black screen issue by upgrading our server infrastructure for stability, improving it significantly


Stay tuned for continuous updates from our team. Your enjoyment is our priority. I want to thank you for playing our game ❤
 ❤️

notes.title: Only one day left! SNEAK OUT with us for tomorrow's release! ⏰
notes.notes:
All hands on deck! Buckle up, prepare good snacks, invite your friends and fire up your Steam libraries already. Just one more day (and for some it's even less than 24 hours!) left to the release of Sneak Out! Are you ready for this crazy ride? Deadly hide-and-seek fun is already waiting for you just around the corner! 

 Sneak Out - our beloved project, made by small group of passionate people is finally going to be released tomorrow! We're happy, thrilled and excited at the same time, just thinking of all fo you, booting up the game and having fun! Whoooa! It is for moments like that, we do it and that moment is about to come! 🔥

If you are curious about the specific hours of game's availability in your regions, we rush to help you - here is infographic with the information you need ⤵️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190768/bf6a93583a38954ea1099fe9de09c177de14718c.jpg

Remember (and yes, we will remind you of this very, very oooooften! 😎), if you have any questions, suggestions, feedback, opinions, questions, answers, compliments... Just anything - we're here for you! Hit us up on Steam forum, Discord, our social media channels  - you name it. We're happy to help and solve any issues! 💪


  Well, so what, until tomorrow! ✌️
